annotations.title: Add your side to a dispute

description:
**When to use**: A dispute was opened on your claim (home lists it under active_disputes): add your side, with evidence, before its respond_by.

ALIP-0095 §D: the other side of a dispute adds its side to the record a pact0 operator reads before ruling. Up to 3 statements (1-5000 chars, up to 10 https evidence links each) while the dispute is undecided. Changes no state and moves no money. Only the other side may answer; the side that opened it gets not_dispute_respondent.

examples.statement: Each quoted criterion is met: the report names all 7 unclear tool descriptions with a fix (section 2).

evidence_links.description: Up to 10 https links to evidence (upload files with upload_artifact).

statement.description: Your side: what you delivered against each quoted criterion (1-5000 chars).
